topics.topic: Required persistence and sharing behavior of the stop mark between request handlers and the serving loop
questions: Replace the implementation choices about a closure variable or server-instance attribute with a behavioral requirement that the stop mark MUST persist across request-handler instances and MUST be observed by the serving loop before another request is accepted.

Replace the implementation choices and HTTPServer-handler explanation with a behavioral requirement that the stop mark MUST be shared between the request handler and outer serving loop and MUST persist after the request handler returns.

Replace the implementation choices and HTTPServer mechanism with a behavioral requirement that the stop mark MUST persist across request-handler instances and MUST be observed by the serving loop before another request is accepted.

quotes: The mark is one object that serve_kernel creates before serving and that the handler sets and the loop reads — a variable of serve_kernel's closure or an attribute of the server instance — never an attribute of the handler instance, because HTTPServer builds a new handler for every request and a mark set on it is lost when the request ends.
judgement.why: The note prescribes specific storage mechanisms and explains the HTTPServer implementation instead of stating only the required persistence and observation behavior.

author_guidance: Before editing, identify the decision's owning state from the phase purpose, question_scope and layer obligations, then choose a disposition for each topic that awaits one.
fixed: repair a decision the owning state must make; do not add later-layer implementation choices merely to close a topic. Record the fix commit and review the changed text once.

carried: name the receiving layer and use --what to preserve the choice, its options and consequences, and the required guarantee every option must keep. Decide any guarantee owned here before carrying its execution onward.
accepted: explain why the remaining choice is permitted. Bring an unresolved product choice to the owner with its options and consequences; absence of a quoted requirement does not decide it.
contradiction and standard_violation take no disposition: repair the offending text in its owning state and review the change. Deterministic transition findings must also close through their checks.
